versions.changelog:
- Añadido archivo README.md con información de referencia.
- Ajustado el campo "requires" en metadata para eliminar dependencia explícita de `gcal.enabled`.
- Sin cambios en los flujos principales ni en las instrucciones del skill.
- Pequeñas mejoras de compatibilidad para facilitar la instalación y configuración.

Initial release of Touch the Grass: a personal reconnection skill for stressful work weeks.

- Detects user stress or burnout and suggests mood-appropriate offline activities.
- Integrates with Google Calendar to schedule activities, including reminders.
- Tracks points (score), daily streaks, and mood improvements with visual/photo verification.
- Proactively reminds users once daily to complete activities, with a gentle, non-intrusive tone.
- Offers summary and progress tracking on request.
- Supports easy one-time setup via cron or heartbeat options.
